verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway lets you declare policies that act automatically on each request event. Prompt Guards act on any chat or completions request, guardrails validate requests and responses before forwarding, rate limits are enforced, and cost signals drive budget enforcement and spend limits. These are request-path policies, though, not a general event-to-action automation engine. Missing for 10: user-defined triggers on non-request events (e.g., budget thresholds or errors), configurable actions such as webhooks or notifications, workflow-style rule chaining, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
